items.question: How do patients save significantly on dental treatment by choosing Linova in Istanbul?
items.answer: Turkey's favorable economic structure — lower operating costs, advantageous exchange rates, and strong government investment in healthcare — means that world-class dental treatments can be offered at a fraction of Western prices. This is not a compromise in quality. Linova uses the same internationally certified implant brands, premium ceramic materials, and advanced digital technology as leading clinics in Europe and the USA. Patients consistently find that the savings are substantial enough to cover their entire trip — flights, accommodation, and treatment — and still pay less than they would at home.

items.question: Is it really safe to have dental treatment in Turkey?
items.answer: Absolutely. Turkey welcomes over 500,000 international dental patients every year — and for good reason. Linova Clinic operates under Turkish Ministry of Health standards, and our dentists hold internationally recognized certifications. We use only EU and FDA-approved implant systems and materials. Every procedure follows strict sterile surgical protocols, and all treatments come with a written warranty. Thousands of patients from the UK, Europe, the Gulf, and Russia have trusted Linova — and left with smiles that speak for themselves.

items.question: How does Linova take care of me from the moment I land in Istanbul?
items.answer:
From your first message to your flight home, we handle everything:
 Before you arrive: Free online consultation, personalized treatment plan, and full cost breakdown — within 24 hours. When you land: VIP airport transfer directly to your hotel or clinic — no stress, no confusion. During treatment: Dedicated multilingual coordinator (English, Arabic, Russian) with you every step of the way. Free time: Curated Istanbul experiences between appointments — the Bosphorus, historic sites, world-class dining. When you leave: Full treatment records, aftercare kit, and ongoing WhatsApp support.

items.question: How do I get started — do I need to fly to Istanbul just for a consultation?
items.answer: Not at all. Your journey starts from home, for free. Simply send us photos of your teeth and any existing X-rays via WhatsApp or our contact form. Our specialist team will assess your case and send you a detailed treatment plan with transparent pricing — usually within 24 hours. Once you are happy with the plan, we help you coordinate your travel dates, hotel, and airport transfer. Most treatments are completed in one or two visits, and we make sure every day counts.

items.question: What happens if I have a problem after I return home?
items.answer: Your care does not end when your flight takes off. Every Linova patient receives a written warranty on their treatment, complete digital records and X-rays, and direct access to their patient coordinator via WhatsApp for any questions. For minor concerns, our team provides remote guidance and video consultations at no extra charge. If in-person follow-up is ever needed, we coordinate with trusted partner clinics internationally — so no matter where you are in the world, you are never left without support.

travelFaq.title: Travel FAQ
travelFaq.subtitle: Practical answers for patients flying to Istanbul.

items.question: Is Istanbul safe for tourists?
items.answer: Like any large city, use normal precautions: licensed taxis or apps, keep valuables secure, and follow local advice. Millions of tourists visit yearly; our coordinators share up-to-date tips for your stay.

items.question: What languages are spoken at the clinic?
items.answer: We regularly serve patients in English, Arabic, Turkish, and other languages via coordinators — tell us your preference when you book.

items.question: Do I need a visa?
items.answer: Many nationalities can use Turkey’s e-Visa or enter visa-free for tourism. Rules change — check the official Republic of Turkey e-Visa site for your passport before booking flights.

items.question: What currency should I bring?
items.answer: Turkish Lira (TRY) is used locally; cards work widely in hotels and malls. Your package pricing is agreed in advance in the currency we quote.

items.question: How do I get from the airport?
items.answer: Our packages include coordinated transfers. You’ll be met at the airport or picked up from your hotel for clinic visits as per your tier.

items.question: What should I wear — especially as a Muslim patient?
items.answer: Dress modestly if you plan to visit mosques (shoulders/knees covered; women may need a headscarf). In daily life and at the clinic, comfortable casual dress is fine. Our team can advise per season.

items.question: How far in advance should I book?
items.answer: We suggest at least 2–3 weeks for simpler cases and more for complex full-mouth work, so we can align hotel and lab timing. Rush cases may be possible — ask us.
